source.reference: Joomla 5 site "Tracy Base" served at http://127.0.0.1:8216 (T4 template `tracy`, OpenDesign apple tokens), captured 2026-09-15 as vendor/joomla/html/tracy_base/ — pages/<path>.html are the bytes the site returned, data/*.json the content export (D2), SNAPSHOT.json the reference list; hashes locked at P1. Revision 21 (11/10/2026, TCH #1180): the nine data/*.json files of that export were never in git (the root .gitignore line `data/` took them) and no copy is left on any machine this repo can reach, so the contracts gate failed everywhere; they leave the inventory (their hashes: vendor/joomla/html/IMPORT-NOTE.md) and every file left is checked as before

exceptions.reason: the source has no designed 404: pages/nope-404-probe.html is Joomla's bare error document (no template CSS), so the page-ground pair exists only to keep the 404 axis measured; its values are not a reference

fonts.platform: macOS (Chrome). No webfont ships (D8): the site declares the system stack (-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", …) and macOS paints San Francisco (".SF NS"); the source declares "SF Pro Text"/"SF Pro Display" first, names macOS only resolves when the developer fonts are installed, and paints Helvetica Neue here (evidence/contract-measure/fonts-probe.txt). Another OS needs its own approved list.
